evidence: Labled Tests and changes test/functional/test_framework/test_node.py and util.py to adjust node maxconnections under -ipcbind.
rationale: Fixes broken test framework execution for IPC tests on NetBSD platforms. As noted in commit 62571e7e67, 'the framework's -maxconnections=76 no longer fits the 256 file descriptor budget on NetBSD, and every interface_ipc*.py node starts with 'Warning: Reducing -maxconnections ...', which the framework treats as a failure.'
